head: 70be6ba2c
problems: Minor: the Auto attack switch sits at the bottom of a long Controls tab, under the full key list and the cast-mode table. At 1920x1080 and 1366x768 you must scroll to find it. Not a defect.
Minor: the description only says what Off does, so it reads a little odd beside an ON switch. 'Stands still' could also be read as 'does not move'. Players will still understand it.

checks.code_review: Command {type:'autoAttack', on} is validated in world.ts. It is applied in core.ts to that seat's own fighter only (Entity.seatAutoOff) and mirrored on Player.autoAttack. In attack.ts, only the ORDER_NONE idle branch reads it, so attack orders, attack-move and attack in place are untouched. stateDigest hashes an explicit field list that includes neither new flag, so default-on matches cannot change their digest. The controller sends the command only when the setting differs from the seat's view value. Every command path, local and facade, uses validCommand.

probes.tsc: no errors outside other lanes' _tmp_/_ab_ files

live_chrome.setup: Own vite dev server on :5199, started and stopped by me. Real Chrome (playwright-core, channel chrome, fresh profile) with real mouse and keys. RIFT practice as Lisvel, structures off, harness heal.
live_chrome.default: Settings > Controls shows Auto attack ON on a fresh profile.
live_chrome.off_persists: Clicking the switch turns it OFF. After a reload it is still OFF. The match starts with the seat off (PlayerView.autoAttack false, seatAutoOff true).
live_chrome.idle_10s_beside_wicks: 0 swings in 10 s, with 6 enemy Wicks in attack range the whole time and the fighter being hit.
live_chrome.right_click: Right-click on a Wick sent attack; 8 swings until it died. Then 0 swings in 5 s and order back to idle, with 5 enemy Wicks still in range.
live_chrome.attack_move: A + left-click on open ground behind the fighter sent move{attackMove:true}; it acquired and swung twice in 3 s.
live_chrome.last_hit: Right-click on a Wick at 48 HP: CS went from 2 to 3.
live_chrome.mid_match_on: Esc > Settings > Controls > switch ON in the pause menu, then back to the match. One autoAttack{on:true} command was sent, the seat went on, and idle beside Wicks gave 4 swings in 5 s.
live_chrome.on_persists: After a reload, Settings > Controls shows ON.
live_chrome.layout: 1920x1080 and 1366x768: label, description and switch line up with the other rows; no clipping and no horizontal scroll. The optional key row 'Turn auto attack on or off' shows unbound (—).

checks.determinism: Default-on digests match the pre-lane baselines (lane 5edfad52, FRAY 441084ba, lane with stops 29f3e850). The same stream run twice gives equal digests. The digest field list leaves out the new flags.
checks.opponent_unaffected: The probe shows equal opponent swing counts with the switch on and off, and through the facade only the human seat changes.

cleanup: Deleted my _harness/_tmp_vfy_aa_r1.* and the shots, stopped the :5199 server and closed the browser tab.
